name: HEAVENLY METAL
clue: Named for a planet found just eight years before it, this element identified in 1789 later fueled the bomb dropped on Hiroshima

name: PIT STOP
clue: Its name comes from the Nahuatl 'ahuacatl,' and its Hass variety traces back to one tree grown by a California mailman

name: THE SCOTTISH POWER PLAY
clue: The Scot whose improved steam engines drove the Industrial Revolution lends his name to this unit, one joule per second

name: TORTOISE TERRITORY
clue: Named for an old Spanish word for their giant tortoises, this Ecuadorian archipelago gave Darwin food for thought
